page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture compute-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs from the Intel Xeon 6462C processor family, running at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network performance is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth configuration. There are no integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this server type.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated Intel Xeon processor allocation, this instance is designed for compute-bound workloads that require consistent CPU performance without massive memory footprints. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for high-compute scenarios such as batch processing, web serving, and application servers where local storage is not a prerequisite and network demands fit within the 8 Gbps baseline.
